text.text: Who is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of every creature:
And thou shalt say unto Pharaoh, Thus saith the Lord, Israel is my son, even my firstborn:
To the general assembly and church of the firstborn, which are written in heaven, and to God the Judge of all, and to the spirits of just men made perfect,
But we thy people, whom thou hast called thy firstborn, thy only begotten, and thy fervent lover, are given into their hands.
Whom, being his firstborn, he nourisheth with discipline, and giving him the light of his love doth not forsake him.
